method: Independent reread of exact subsection text and separate inspection of case-plan comparisons and constructed controller targets.

covered_clauses.clause: left turn from a two-directional highway onto a one-way highway
covered_clauses.limitation: Actual Native route directions, intersection and public-highway status are unverified.

covered_clauses.clause: approach in right half nearest centerline
covered_clauses.limitation: The two positive approach targets sample position but do not establish a legal near-centerline cutoff.

covered_clauses.clause: as close as practicable to left-hand curb of the one-way highway
covered_clauses.limitation: The two departure setpoints are physical samples; practicability is unresolved.

covered_clauses.clause: turning from the right of the centerline where it enters the intersection
covered_clauses.limitation: Positive and full-body-straddling diagnostic sources compare the entry-side geometry; original Native physical realization remains unverified.
